scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n DX,GIT -c blue,green "bun run dev:dx" "bun run dev:git"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n DX,EMPIRE,MOON,EISP,RID,GIT,ARSY,LEGEND -c blue,yellow,cyan,magenta,red,green,yellow,white "bun run dev:dx" "bun run dev:empire" "bun run dev:moon" "bun run dev:eisp" "bun run dev:rid" "bun run dev:git" "bun run dev:arsy" "bun run dev:legend"
scripts.build:all: bun --filter @local-git/dx build && bun --filter @local-git/empire build && bun --filter @local-git/moonwitness build && bun --filter @local-git/e-isp build && bun --filter @local-git/rid build && bun --filter @local-git/arsy build
scripts.check: bun --filter @local-git/ui check && bun --filter @local-git/dx check && bun --filter @local-git/empire check && bun --filter @local-git/moonwitness check && bun --filter @local-git/e-isp check && bun --filter @local-git/rid check && bun --filter @local-git/engine check && bun --filter @local-git/arsy check
scripts.test: bun --filter @local-git/contracts test && bun --filter @local-git/engine test && bun --filter @local-git/arsy test
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path services/legend/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path services/radius/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path services/legend/Cargo.toml --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path services/radius/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path services/legend/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path services/radius/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
